title: MAAAAASSIVE XRP ANNOUNCEMENT!! US GOV🤝 XRP !
description:
MAAAAASSIVE XRP ANNOUNCEMENT!! (US GOV🤝 XRP?!) | April 24, 2026

The walls are finally coming down! As of April 24, 2026, the relationship between Ripple and the US Government has taken its most historic turn yet. With the introduction of the PACE Act (Payments Access and Consumer Efficiency Act) by Rep. Young Kim and Sam Liccardo, the path for Ripple to gain direct access to the Federal Reserve payment rails is officially open. This isn't just a rumor—this is a bipartisan legislative move to modernize America’s core payment infrastructure.

In this emergency update, we break down:

    The PACE Act: How Ripple (as a qualified provider) can now bypass traditional banking layers to settle directly with the Fed.

    The CLARITY Act Senate Markup: Why the Senate Banking Committee, chaired by Tim Scott, is about to lock XRP’s "Digital Commodity" status into federal law.

    SWIFT Certification: Ripple Treasury’s official status as a SWIFT-compatible partner and what it means for the $13 Trillion payments shift.

    Price Analysis: XRP is holding strong at $1.43, but with the 28-29 April FOMC meeting approaching, are we about to see the "Clarity Breakout"?

If you hold XRP, this is the "US GOV partnership" moment you have been waiting for. Don't let the noise distract you from the legislation.

Hit that LIKE button if you’re holding until the $10 mark, and SUBSCRIBE to Oval Breakdown for the fastest breaking news in the crypto world!

#XRP #Ripple #XRPArmy #CryptoNews #PACEAct #ClarityAct #USGov #OvalBreakdown #XRPPricePrediction #FedAccess

0:00 - The Massive US Gov & XRP Connection Visual: Headlines of the PACE Act and the Ripple logo next to the Federal Reserve seal.

2:15 - Breaking Down the PACE Act: Direct Fed Access Visual: On-screen graphics showing how the bill allows Ripple to access federal payment rails directly.

4:30 - Senate Markup Update: The CLARITY Act Final Phase Visual: Video clips of Senator Tim Scott and Paul Atkins discussing the upcoming committee vote.

6:45 - Ripple Treasury & SWIFT Integration Visual: Documentation of the SWIFT Certified Partner program and ISO 20022 implementation.

8:50 - My XRP Action Plan & April Price Targets Visual: Technical analysis chart showing the $1.43 support and the $1.60 - $2.80 breakout zones.
